title: Supports of boundaries, weak limits and linear combinations
statement: (1) For P, m ∈ ℕ, any U ⊆ ℝ^P and Z ∈ D_{m+1}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (m+1)): spt ∂Z ⊆ spt Z. (2) For P, n ∈ ℕ, open U ⊆ ℝ^P, closed K ⊆ ℝ^P and Z_j, Z ∈ D_n(U) with spt Z_j ⊆ K for all j and Z_j ⇀ Z: spt Z ⊆ K. (3) For P, n ∈ ℕ, open U ⊆ ℝ^P, Z_1, Z_2, Z ∈ D_n(U) and a, b ∈ ℝ with Z(ω) = a·Z_1(ω) + b·Z_2(ω) for all ω ∈ D^n(U): spt Z ⊆ spt Z_1 ∪ spt Z_2.
lean_statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), Z.boundary.support ⊆ Z.support) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)) (Zj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsClosed K → (∀ j, (Zj j).support ⊆ K) → WeaklyConvergesOn Zj Z → Z.support ⊆ K) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Z₁ Z₂ Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = a * Z₁ ω + b * Z₂ ω) → Z.support ⊆ Z₁.support ∪ Z₂.support)
